paragraphs.text: Coadministration or simultaneous administration of vaccines refers to giving or getting more than one vaccine during a visit. This is common clinical practice. While there are some exceptions, most vaccines can be given at the same visit.

People can get a flu vaccine and COVID-19 vaccine at the same visit if they are eligible, and if the timing for each vaccine is right. IIV3s and RIV3 can be administered simultaneously or sequentially with other inactivated vaccines or live vaccines.
